title: Large language models for conducting systematic reviews: on the rise, but not yet ready for use – a scoping review

live_model.evidence: Summary table cataloguing external studies, row: "(13) Hasan 2024+ US, val GPT 4, GPT 4 Turbo RoB Agreement of GPT-4 vs. Cochrane reviewers...".

prompt.note: This is a scoping review of other papers' LLM use; the authors run no model themselves.

notes: A scoping review cataloguing roughly twenty external studies that used GPT-4/GPT-4 Turbo/ChatGPT for systematic-review tasks; GPT-4 Turbo appears only as a table entry describing one such external study (Hasan 2024), never as a model the review's own authors ran.
